title: Pure Majespecter
summary: Majespecter cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Every Majespecter is a WIND Spellcaster Pendulum that can't be targeted or destroyed by the opponent's effects, and most of them search on summon: Bunbuku a monster, Yata a Spell, Kyubi a Trap, and Ogama Sets a Spell/Trap. Their Spells and Traps tribute a WIND Spellcaster to destroy, bounce, banish or negate. Since the Pendulums return through the Extra Deck, the deck never runs out of tribute fodder. The 2024 cards lead. Majespecter Porcupine summons itself on either Main Phase and Sets a Majespecter Spell from the GY. Majespecter Wind tributes to summon a Majespecter from the Deck. Majespecter Orthrus - Nue returns Pendulums from the Extra Deck to the hand and refills the Extra Deck from the Deck. Majespecter Draco - Ryu searches as a Scale.
